sourceCorrection.summary: The strict reduced-mode test now opens the rendered Settings panel and targets its actual semantic groups and slider before asserting visibility.

verification.command: KYX_PHASE8_A11Y_STRICT=1 KYX_PHASE8_POINTER_LOCK_PROBE=1 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test accessibility/phase8-runtime.spec.ts --project=chromium-desktop --reporter=line
covered: strict keyboard focus and visible focus indicator
HUD scale, subtitles, high-contrast, and Camera / HUD Motion controls
pointer-lock acquisition, Escape release, pause visibility, and Resume focus restoration

browserZoomProbe.result: The in-app browser did not forward a measurable browser-level zoom change; this is not accepted as literal browser-zoom evidence.

limitations: Literal 125% and 200% browser zoom remains unproven; existing CSS-viewport equivalents are supporting evidence only.
Human NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver acceptance remains required.
